description: This is a shell script used for testing Git functionalities related to rebasing with changing encodings, including setup, merging, rebasing, and encoding comparison operations.

methods.name: compare_msg
methods.description: Compares the content of a specified message file with the latest commit, converting encoding as needed.

methods.name: test_rebase_continue_update_encode
methods.description: Tests the rebase operation's ability to continue after updating commit encoding preferences.
